sections.name: About Us
sections.copy: Poultry Farming Foods Technology Limited is a leading Nigerian FoodTech company dedicated to modernizing poultry farming through cutting-edge agricultural technology. Based in Bwari, we combine traditional farming expertise with innovative solutions to meet the growing demand for quality poultry products across Nigeria. Our commitment to food safety, sustainable farming practices, and technological innovation sets us apart in the industry. We work directly with farmers, distributors, and retailers to ensure the highest standards from production to consumption.

sections.name: Our Services
sections.copy:
**Poultry Production & Management**
Comprehensive poultry farming solutions utilizing advanced breeding techniques, automated feeding systems, and climate-controlled housing for optimal bird health and productivity.

**Quality Poultry Products Supply**
Fresh, farm-to-table poultry products including live birds, dressed chicken, eggs, and processed poultry items delivered across Nigeria with full traceability and quality assurance.

**AgriTech Consulting**
Expert guidance for farmers looking to modernize their operations. We provide technology integration, farm management systems, and sustainable farming practices consultation.

**Feed Production & Nutrition**
Scientifically formulated poultry feeds designed for different growth stages, ensuring optimal nutrition, faster growth rates, and better meat quality.

**Cold Chain & Distribution**
Reliable cold storage and distribution network ensuring your poultry products reach markets in perfect condition, maintaining freshness from our farms to your customers.

sections.name: Why Choose Us
sections.copy:
**Technology-Driven Excellence**
We leverage the latest agricultural technology to optimize every aspect of poultry production, from automated monitoring systems to data-driven decision making.

**Quality Assurance**
Every product undergoes rigorous quality control. We maintain the highest standards of hygiene, safety, and freshness in all our operations.

**Sustainable Practices**
Our commitment to environmental sustainability means we employ eco-friendly farming methods, waste management systems, and energy-efficient operations.

**Local Expertise, Global Standards**
As a proudly Nigerian company, we understand local market needs while maintaining international quality standards.

**Reliable Supply Chain**
With our established distribution network across Nigeria, we ensure consistent, timely delivery of poultry products to meet your business needs.

sections.name: Get In Touch
sections.copy:
Ready to partner with Nigeria's leading poultry FoodTech company? Whether you're a retailer looking for reliable poultry supply, a farmer seeking consultation, or an investor interested in agricultural innovation, we're here to help.

Visit our office at 138 Byazhin Road, Byazhin Kubwa, Second Choice, Bwari, or reach out through any of our contact channels. Our team is ready to discuss how Poultry Farming Foods Technology Limited can support your poultry business needs.

For immediate inquiries, call us or send a WhatsApp message. We respond to all enquiries within 24 hours.
